ZOAN:
→ (A city in Egypt)
→ Built seven years after Hebron in the land of Canaan Numbers 13:22
→ Prophecies concerning Ezekiel 30:14
→ Wise men from, were counselors of Pharaoh Isaiah 19:11,Isaiah 19:13
→ Princes of Isaiah 30:4
ZOAR:
→ A city of the Moabites, near the Jordan River Genesis 13:10
→ Territory of Deuteronomy 34:3; Isaiah 15:5; Jeremiah 48:34
→ King of, fought against Chedorlaomer Genesis 14:2,Genesis 14:8
→ Not destroyed with Sodom and Gomorrah Genesis 19:20-23,Genesis 19:30
ZOBAH:
→ Also called ZOBA; ARAM-ZOBAH; HAMATH-ZOBAH
→ A kingdom in the north of Palestine 1 Samuel 14:47
→ Conquest of, by David 2 Samuel 8:3-8,2 Samuel 8:12; 1 Kings 11:23,1 Kings 11:24; 1 Chronicles 18:2-9
→ Its inhabitants mercenaries of the Ammonites against David 2 Samuel 10:6-19; 1 Chronicles 19:6-19
→ David writes a psalm after the conquest of, see the title of Psalms 60
→ Invaded by Solomon 2 Chronicles 8:3
ZOHAR:
1. Father of Ephron Genesis 23:8; Genesis 25:9
2. Son of Simeon Genesis 46:10; Exodus 6:15
ZOPHAR: → One of Job' s three friends Job 2:11; Job 11; Job 20; Job 42:7-9
ZOPHIM:
1. A place on the top of Pisgah Numbers 23:14
2. A city on Mount Ephraim 1 Samuel 1:1
ZORAH:
→ Also called ZAREAH and ZOREAH
→ A city of the tribe of Dan or possibly the tribe of Judah Joshua 15:33; Joshua 19:41
→ The city of Samson Judges 13:2,Judges 13:24,Judges 13:25; Judges 16:31
→ Representatives of the tribe of Dan sent from, to spy out the land with a view to its conquest Judges 18
→ Fortified by Rehoboam 2 Chronicles 11:10
→ Re-populated after the captivity Nehemiah 11:29
ZOROBABEL:
→ Also called, ZERUBBABEL SHESHBAZZAR
→ An ancestor of Joseph Matthew 1:12,Matthew 1:13; Luke 3:27
→ See ZERUBBABAL
